value.rationale: Addresses a motivated distributional gap in current four-mechanism catastrophe–dispersion branching theory: first moments do not control survival probabilities or quenched path comparisons. Completes all-capacity first-order order and an arbitrary-environment pathwise transfer, beyond the previously known d=2,3 geometric special cases; exact capacity-two extinction calculation illustrates nontrivial survival/extinction phase separation. Value does not rest on finite computations or merely rebranding the prior mean inequality.
